changelog:
Initial release of Premium Web UI Designer.

- Transforms websites, web apps, dashboards, SaaS products, landing pages, portfolios, and tools into polished, premium interfaces.
- Focuses on clear design hierarchy, confident spacing, refined typography, purposeful component states, and responsive layouts.
- Outlines a structured workflow for analyzing product type, selecting a style direction, defining a design system, and applying refined layout/visual details.
- Includes do/don’t rules for modern frontend design (color use, iconography, responsiveness, semantic structure, and visual polish).
- Provides a checklist for editing code and delivering accessible, visually validated frontends.
- Sets output standards for summarizing design direction, key changes, responsive verification, and limitations.
summary: Improve websites and web apps with clearer layout, better visual hierarchy, modern UI styling, responsive checks, and polished frontend design suggestions or code changes.
